item.text:
**7B.3**
Verdict: mixed, leaning negative.

Search gap: I found strong 2024 allegations about family-linked procurement and several state-capture style reforms, plus some official denials and anti-corruption actions. I did not find a strong independent 2024 audit proving AMLO personally profited; the clearest negative evidence is about his family network, allies, and institutional changes that concentrated power.

**Negative**
- [El Clan: los primos de Andy y “Bobby” López Beltrán, y sus contratos en el gobierno de AMLO](https://latinus.us/mexico/2024/2/20/el-clan-los-primos-de-andy-bobby-lopez-beltran-sus-contratos-en-el-gobierno-de-amlo-108263.html) - LatinUS, 2024-02-20. Claim: the investigation alleges a family-linked influence network around López Obrador’s sons touched Tren Maya and Pemex contracts, suggesting private/family ties could shape public procurement. IDs: `7B.3`.
- [Quién es Osterlen Salazar Beltrán, el primo de los hijos de AMLO señalado por tener contratos millonarios con Pemex](https://www.infobae.com/mexico/2024/02/21/quien-es-osterlen-salazar-beltran-el-primo-de-los-hijos-de-amlo-senalado-por-tener-contratos-millonarios-con-pemex/) - Infobae, 2024-02-21. Claim: relatives of AMLO’s sons were reported to have won Pemex contracts through a family company, another sign of possible family-business overlap. IDs: `7B.3`.
- [Mexico constitutional reforms more likely with supermajority in sight](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexico-constitutional-reforms-more-likely-with-supermajority-in-sight-3469906) - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-06-04. Claim: Reuters reported AMLO pushed an INE overhaul critics saw as a way to cement Morena’s hegemony, meaning state institutional design was being used for ruling-coalition advantage. IDs: `7B.3`, `7B.2`.
- [Mexico’s sweeping judicial overhaul formally takes effect](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexicos-sweeping-judicial-overhaul-formally-takes-effect-3616588) - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-09-15. Claim: the government enacted a judicial overhaul widely criticized for weakening judicial independence, reducing neutral constraints on power. IDs: `7B.3`, `7B.2`.
- [Mexican senators push through reform to boost military control over security](https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexican-senators-push-through-reform-to-boost-military-control-over-security-3632396) - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-09-25. Claim: the reform shifted law-and-order power toward the military, which critics said expanded coercive state power rather than separating it from political interests. IDs: `7B.3`.

**Positive / mitigating**
- [Gobierno federal presenta caso de evasion fiscal de Totalplay debe mas de mil 500 millones de pesos al SAT](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/gobierno-federal-presenta-caso-de-evasion-fiscal-de-totalplay-debe-mas-de-mil-500-millones-de-pesos-al-sat/) - Presidencia de México, 2024-03-15. Claim: AMLO’s government publicly pursued a tax-evasion case against a politically connected company, evidence of enforcing rules against a business actor rather than shielding allies. IDs: `7B.3`.
- [Gobierno de México mantiene demanda en Florida para recuperar 634 mdd por trama de corrupción de García Luna](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/gobierno-de-mexico-mantiene-demanda-en-florida-para-recuperar-634-mdd-por-trama-de-corrupcion-de-garcia-luna/) - Presidencia de México, 2024-02-16. Claim: the administration kept pursuing asset recovery from a major corruption case, which is at least some evidence of using state power against corruption rather than for private gain. IDs: `7B.3`.
- [Mexican finance minister seeks to soothe investors, reduce public debt](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/mexican-finance-minister-seeks-to-soothe-investors-reduce-public-debt-3470241) - Reuters via Investing.com, 2024-06-04. Claim: Rogelio Ramírez de la O stayed on, backed central bank autonomy and the rule of law, and reassured investors, which supports a technocratic and relatively non-personalized economic-policy lane. IDs: `7B.3`.
- [29.04.24 Versión estenográfica de la conferencia de prensa matutina del presidente Andrés Manuel López Obrador](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/29-04-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/) - Presidencia de México, 2024-04-29. Claim: AMLO denied his sons were involved in Tren Maya business and said he would not intervene with the prosecutor for them; this is limited counterevidence, though it is self-interested and not independently verified. IDs: `7B.3`, `7B.2`.
- [25.06.24 Versión estenográfica de la conferencia de prensa matutina del presidente Andrés Manuel López Obrador](https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/25-06-24-version-estenografica-de-la-conferencia-de-prensa-matutina-del-presidente-andres-manuel-lopez-obrador/) - Presidencia de México, 2024-06-25. Claim: AMLO said he would not seek reelection and would leave office, which is relevant as evidence against treating the presidency as a personal asset. IDs: `7B.3`, `7B.2`.

Net: the best 2024 evidence points to family-linked procurement allegations and power-concentrating reforms, with only limited, mostly official counterevidence showing AMLO drew any meaningful boundary between personal/family interests and state decisions.
